sections.title: A piece of *Aiken history*

image.alt: The front porch of the Main Inn with the Carriage House Inn sign

body: The Main Inn was built around 1872 as a family home, beside a garage that changed oil in ten minutes and ran limousine and taxi service. Fred Astaire is said to have danced at birthday parties there, and much later Disney used the property as production headquarters for That Darn Cat.
Restored and opened as a six-room inn in 1999, the Carriage House Inn has grown to 37 rooms and suites in three historic buildings. It is locally owned and operated: Southern hospitality at its best.

columns.title: Guest services
items: Luggage stored until your room is ready

items.a: Check-in is guaranteed at 3 pm and check-out is at 11 am. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability, and we’ll store your luggage free until your room is ready.
Yes, guests must be at least 21 to check in.
Yes. ADA-compliant rooms are available and should be reserved in advance.
A hair dryer, coffee maker, cable TV, free Wi-Fi and a private bathroom. Suites with kitchens are available, and the Main Inn and Laurens Guest House share a mini-fridge and microwave.

items.q: Can I book for Masters Week?
items.a: Yes. Call guest services at (803) 644-5888. Payment is required when you book, and Masters Week reservations are non-refundable.
